basic_info.description: Experience the perfect blend of modern convenience and sophisticated city living at this beautifully updated SOMA residence. Freshly painted and move-in ready, this stylish home features nearly new cabinetry, premium appliances, and a versatile movable island, making the kitchen both functional and elegant. An in-unit washer/dryer adds everyday ease. The secure building boasts a private garage with a deeded parking stall and extra storage, ensuring both safety and convenience. Enjoy the building's signature rooftop deck offering stunning 360-degree views of San Francisco's iconic skyline  the perfect backdrop for entertaining or unwinding. Commuters will appreciate seamless access to public transit and major freeways.  With low HOA dues, this home offers exceptional value in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods. Don't miss your opportunity to embrace urban luxury with style, comfort, and unbeatable city access.
